summary: Iteration 9: Full backend + frontend validation of pre-Phase-3 enhancements (crypto wallet redesign with dropdowns, card CVV, editable profile details, provider availability + price list). All 11 backend pytest cases PASSED (crypto add/list/delete, invalid token, empty address, CVV non-persistence, profile contact/preferences, availability, price_list). Frontend E2E: payments-settings (BUSINESS token) shows CVV field, crypto add form uses token dropdown → auto-suggests network → save creates card (crypto-wallet-<id>) → delete removes it. profile-details fully functional: address/phone/email/preferences fields save, day chips toggle, working hours persist, price list add/edit/delete works and persists via PUT /api/profile. All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Aggiungi voce' (add-price-item) button sits at y≈780 which overlaps the absolutely-positioned footer containing save-details (y≈778). When the price list is empty, the add button is visually hidden BEHIND the footer bar and touch/click can be intercepted by the Save button when not scrolled. Needs bottom padding on ScrollView contentContainerStyle (currently 160) or the footer to have a solid opaque background so it does not visually collide; alternatively move Aggiungi voce above the footer safe area.

issues: Add-price-item button overlaps with the fixed Salva footer at 390x844 viewport when price list is empty (only visible after user scrolls the ScrollView up).

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits repeated warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Multiple screens (payments-settings, profile-details, and others) use shadow.card from /app/frontend/src/theme.ts which likely still uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on web. Migrate to boxShadow (RN 0.76+/Expo SDK 52 web). Reference: theme.ts (shadow.card).

action_items: Optional UX polish: increase profile-details ScrollView paddingBottom above the fixed footer (currently 160) OR reposition the 'Aggiungi voce' link so it never sits under the Salva footer when the list is empty.
Migrate shadow.* style props to boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.py:32-35: PaymentMethodIn.dict(exclude={'cvv'}) correctly strips CVV before persisting — verified by test.
wallet.py:46-59: crypto-wallet PUT validates token against ALLOWED_TOKENS and trims empty address — proper 400 errors returned.
auth.py:58-72: ProfileUpdate correctly persists new optional fields (address, phone, contact_email, preferences, availability, price_list) via dict-exclude-None pattern.
Dropdown.tsx: modal + testID pattern is clean; option testID format '{testID}-opt-{value}' works well for automation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows verified: payments CVV, crypto dropdown+add+delete, profile-details fields, availability chips, working hours, price list add/edit/persist)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing seeded accounts (biz-test-token-999, demo-preview-token-123). Test data created was cleaned up (crypto wallets deleted after add; profile fields reset to empty at end of frontend flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration-9 enhancements (crypto dropdowns, CVV field, editable profile-details incl. availability + price_list) are working end-to-end. Only remaining polish item is the add-price-item button overlapping the fixed Salva footer when the price list is empty. shadow* deprecation warnings on RN Web are cosmetic. No blockers for Phase 3.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Minor UX overlap: profile-details.tsx uses an absolutely positioned footer (position: absolute, bottom: 0) with paddingBottom: 160 on ScrollView, but the 'add-price-item' Pressable renders inline right above the footer, and when the price list is empty it can sit at y≈780 while the footer's Salva button occupies y≈778-832 — Playwright force-click succeeded only after scrollIntoView. Fix: either lift the priceHead above the footer via extra bottom margin, or make the fixed footer background solid + shorten ScrollView height.
